items.author: alycore.bsky.social
items.context: You ever feel like some multiplatform games just feel like they belong on one platform, above all the others? Examples for me would be Baldur’s Gate 3 feels like a PC game Cyberpunk 2077 feels like a Xbox game Dark Souls feels like a PlayStation game FF Resonance feels like a Nintendo game
items.text: Baldur's Gate 3 on PC does feel right, mostly because mouse and keyboard make juggling a whole party so smooth. Total War games give me the same feeling.

items.author: natapfel.bsky.social
items.context: BioWare games were the first I came across that had queer representation. May have been the only ones back then that did? Ive loved games since I was a toddler, but I think playing these games was the first time I ever saw myself in them. It made me feel like I could belong and add to this industry.
items.text: Glad those games were there for you. Seeing yourself in a story can make a game feel like home.
